topology_reasoning.device_hypothesis: Three-core adiabatic splitter / mode-evolution structure: two outer rails begin as narrow taps, thicken while running parallel to a central core, then peel outward into two wide output guides while the central core tapers down and terminates before the fork.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: The long parallel section sets the interaction / mode-evolution region. The central rail perturbs the local supermodes, and the outward branch transition converts that coupled region into two separated output waveguides. For bitmap recreation, the function-defining geometry is the outer-rail launch widths, the interaction-region widths and length, the central-core taper and stop position, and the branch offset/length that controls the fork shape.
topology_reasoning.measurement_contract_note: For HOMI verification, the script will expose two honest arm centerlines (upper/lower outer rails) in lengths.json. delta_length will add real straight length to the upper output rail, so knob-response area growth is physical rather than reported-only.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only reconstruction: linear-width outer tapers into smooth outward branches, plus a central taper that terminates before the fork.
Recentered the three-rail stack upward slightly and trimmed the center-core taper widths to reduce systematic vertical mismatch and excess middle-core area.
